title: HS256 sign and verify round trip, awaited
summary: Sign a claims object with HS256 into a compact JWT through an awaited (WebCrypto) API, then verify that token and return the verified claims.
notes: The claims and check of hs256-roundtrip, through each package's promise API on one thread: one sign and one verify per operation, each awaited, and the operation awaited before the next starts. The figure is the package's own work (JSON and base64url encoding, header and claims checks) plus two WebCrypto HMAC-SHA256 calls and the promise turns the runtime needs to settle them. The HMAC key is imported once per fixture, outside the timing, in every entry. No timer or sleep is involved.
